# TEST_FIXTURE: Statics Vector Components

Rights: newly authored for AxiomIQ automated tests; non-private.

## Course definition

Statics studies forces in equilibrium. Learners resolve a force vector into
horizontal and vertical components, apply signs from the axis convention, and
check that the component resultant is consistent with the original magnitude.

## Evidence

For a 100 N force at 30 degrees above the positive x-axis, use
`Fx = F cos(theta)` and `Fy = F sin(theta)`. Equilibrium requires the signed
sum of force components to be zero on each axis.
